batch_check.result: Checked 12 items, 34 questions. Keys A9 B9 C9 D7 (26/26/26/21%). Options 3:20, 4:14 (41% four-option). No failures; warnings reviewed (compounds judged transparent; sentence-length warnings are table/list merges; m2 is one unlisted token explained by context).

checks.question_mix: Persona question in every text; purpose question in gezondheidscentrum, schoolstraat, huur-omhoog, stagegesprek, retour-ontvangen (five of twelve).
checks.tables: vakantiesport, stagedagen, fietsles and consultatiebureau use text lines with ' – ' separators and a header line, as in batch021-zwemrooster.
checks.changed_premises: werkplaatsregels (gloves off at machines), ziekmelden (company doctor after a week; no doctor's note) and retour-ontvangen (return label deducted) state nothing untrue for Dutch practice: employers may not ask the nature of the illness, loose gloves are a machine-entanglement hazard, and a seller who has told the consumer may charge return costs.
checks.originality: ziekmelden: no reference text for A2 reading is held locally, so overlap with the official practice exam could not be compared; the text is a garden-centre procedure with its own details (reception fallback, privacy line, holiday rule, company doctor) and nothing was copied. retour-ontvangen: one near-repeat of batch021-terugbrengen was reworded.
checks.slugs: consultatiebureau (KNM batch006) and ziekmelden (speaking batch027) are in other parts; the plan fixes them and the rule is per part, so they stay.
checks.vocabulary: Hard-in-context flags: retouretiket (key of 12 q2, explained by the next sentences), terugkomdag (defined in the text), huurtoeslag and bedrijfsarts (no key depends on them), m2 (one unlisted token).

diversity.within_batch: Eight task types, seven domains; ziekmelden and stagedagen both contain a sick-call rule but for different organisations and procedures; kamer-te-huur and huur-omhoog are both housing but advert versus landlord letter.
diversity.catalogue: No clash with the 43 existing A2 reading titles; closest are batch021-terugbrengen (policy versus single confirmation) and batch004-ramen (krant).
